full_name: Bob Kil | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2025–2026 Arts David and Roberta Logie Fellow Independent Artist (Germany)
bio: Bob Kil depicts a landscape of minimal notations in her performance, conveyed through consistent repetition that juxtaposes subtlety and simplicity with the traditional notion of mastery. During the fellowship at Radcliffe, Kil aims to broaden her focus beyond human-centric themes by exploring the behaviors of other living beings and enriching her choreographic lexicon, ultimately inspiring a collective sense of environmental stewardship through the universal language of movement.
